command:
set -eu
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'crond_active='; systemctl is-active crond
printf 'crond_enabled='; systemctl is-enabled crond
printf '%s\n' '--- /etc/cron.allow ---'
if [ -e /etc/cron.allow ]; then stat -c 'mode=%a owner=%U group=%G' /etc/cron.allow; sed -n '1,40p' /etc/cron.allow; else printf 'absent\n'; fi
printf '%s\n' '--- /etc/cron.deny ---'
if [ -e /etc/cron.deny ]; then stat -c 'mode=%a owner=%U group=%G' /etc/cron.deny; sed -n '1,40p' /etc/cron.deny; else printf 'absent\n'; fi
printf '%s\n' '--- accounts ---'
getent passwd root opsadmin || true

command:
set -eu
printf 'root\nopsadmin\n' | install -o root -g root -m 600 /dev/stdin /etc/cron.allow
restorecon /etc/cron.allow 2>/dev/null || true

set -eu
printf 'root\nopsadmin\n' | install -o root -g root -m 600 /dev/stdin /etc/cron.allow
restorecon /etc/cron.allow 2>/dev/null || true

printf '%s\n' '--- enforced allowlist ---'
stat -c 'mode=%a owner=%U group=%G context=%C' /etc/cron.allow
sed -n '1,10p' /etc/cron.allow
printf '%s\n' '--- root access check ---'
crontab -l >/tmp/root-crontab-check.out 2>/tmp/root-crontab-check.err; rc=$?; printf 'root_rc=%s\n' "$rc"; sed -n '1,5p' /tmp/root-crontab-check.err
printf '%s\n' '--- unauthorized account check ---'
runuser -u nobody -- crontab -l >/tmp/nobody-crontab-check.out 2>/tmp/nobody-crontab-check.err; rc=$?; printf 'nobody_rc=%s\n' "$rc"; sed -n '1,5p' /tmp/nobody-crontab-check.err
printf 'crond_active='; systemctl is-active crond

printf '%s\n' '--- unauthorized account check ---'
runuser -u nobody -- crontab -l >/tmp/nobody-crontab-check.out 2>/tmp/nobody-crontab-check.err; rc=$?; printf 'nobody_rc=%s\n' "$rc"; sed -n '1,5p' /tmp/nobody-crontab-check.err
printf 'crond_active='; systemctl is-active crond
